deploybot: :rotating_light: Deployment alert r-2026-03-21-6375 embed-prod:v2.2.0-canary -> elevated 5xx (~15% over 3m). Blocking promotion. Reply with rollback/pin/approve-rollforward.

jamie: oncall - seeing `tokenizer` CPU flatlines then bursts, traces show high `tokenize_batch()` latency.

rachel: prefer minimal blast: pin at LB to v2.1.9 and scale down canary. Ops, can you apply pin+targeted rollback?

ops-lee: can do LB pin + canary patch. Need release-lead approval for expedited action. Will post audit URL when done.

release-lead: approved: pin and rollback canary only. Keep stable pool untouched and start 10m smoke. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: CI note: build r-2026-03-21-6375 passed tests but perf regression flagged on tokenization p95 in staging (4% increase). https://ci.internal/builds/r-2026-03-21-6375/report

ops-lee: applied LB pin -> routing to v2.1.9 backend. Patch canary image back to v2.1.9: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embed-prod-canary embed=registry/embed:v2.1.9 --record` then `kubectl -n prod scale deploy/embed-prod-canary --replicas=2`.

jamie: confirming LB now shows 100% to v2.1.9. Starting smoke window.

ops-lee: audit: https://audit.internal/ops/6375501234/pin-rollback. Canaries stable, replicas=2.

rachel: smoke looks ok at 6m, no elevated 5xx. Opening ticket REL-2026-421 to add CI perf gate for tokenizer and a rollout metric to block promotion on CPU anomaly.

deploybot: Rollout blocked cleared for r-2026-03-21-6375; canary promotion paused pending fix. Thread closed by release-lead.
